topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by outlining the evolutionary mechanisms, cell of origin characteristics, and microenvironmental factors that drive cancer progression.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Mechanisms of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how clonal expansion and competitive fitness in cancer are driven by the acquisition of advantageous driver mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tissue hierarchy, inherent stemness properties, and specific cells of origin determine tumor initiation and propagation across different cancer types.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion, Tumor Stroma, and Coevolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how microenvironmental cues and chronic inflammation promote tumor outgrowth, support established malignancies, and coevolve with cancer cells, alongside the profiling methods used to study these interactions.

topics.label: Conclusion and Upcoming Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the administrative closing to the lecture and previews the next topic on cancer therapy.
